blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Lapu-Lapu City Police Office (LCPO) reminded residents of the strict implementation of City Ordinance No. 16-055-2022, which imposes penalties for vandalism and other acts of malicious mischief that undermine the city’s Clean and Green Project. The ordinance seeks to protect public and private properties and maintain cleanliness and order throughout the city. Under the ordinance, violators face a fine of ₱3,000 for the first offense and ₱4,000 for the second offense. A third offense carries a fine of ₱5,000 and/or imprisonment, at the discretion of the court. LCPO City Director Police Col. Agosto Daskeo, in an […]...
